decision: Reject both fixed shape additions; retain existing perception candidate and Pi deployment.

soft_fusion_reproduction.method: Revalidated TRAIN provenance and source folds, refitted all five fold models and final model, verified stored model/output hashes, reconstructed predictions and both repeated/deduplicated metrics. Read-only local command after training.

manual_hard_gate_loss_review.scope: Viewed nine unique original crop files. The last rejected view is horizontally flipped; inspected its original file, not the exact flipped runtime tensor. No labels changed.
manual_hard_gate_loss_review.observations: Losses include partial balloons, tiny low-detail crops, balloons with adjacent objects, and clear balloon outlines. Grayscale shape evidence is not a reliable mandatory veto in this fixed experiment. This does not establish that all shape-based methods must fail.
